description: Sent, delivered, bounced, rejected, complained, received and spam over a window of `days` — counted from the event log, so it includes outcomes the provider reported afterwards. Narrow it with `identity_id` for one address or **`pod_id` for one of your customers**, which is the scope sending reputation is isolated at. With a pod, the answer carries `reputation.sending`: `paused` means the provider has suspended that pod and nobody else, and is the reason mail from it is queueing. `delivery_rate` is null rather than zero when nothing was sent. Read this before deciding to keep sending — a rising bounce rate is the signal to stop.
name: get_metrics
title: What happened to the mail
